name: Vivek Kumar
title: UI/UX Designer
profile: UI/UX Designer with about a year of hands-on experience designing websites and AI product interfaces. At AlgoRoot I revamped AlgoJob's AI career platform and the AlgoVox interface, taking work from wireframes and prototypes to high-fidelity Figma files with developer handoff. My case studies combine user research, accessible design systems and motion, from a medicine-care app for older parents to an AI scam checker for families.

bullets: Revamped the UI/UX of AlgoJob's AI career platform, simplifying navigation and information architecture.
Redesigned the AlgoVox product interface and the AlgoRoot website end to end, with clearer visual hierarchy and consistency.
Produced wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity Figma files with developer handoff documentation.
Applied WCAG accessibility standards while working with dev and marketing teams in an agile setup.
Wrote a UX/UI competitive research report on SkillWiz, an EdTech platform.

projects.name: FIKR
bullets: Designed a concept app where a parent confirms medicines with one "Taken" tap, so a child living far away is reassured without the parent feeling watched.
Ran five user interviews and affinity mapping, then built personas, user flows, wireframes, a Material 3 design system with night mode and a bilingual UI.

projects.name: Shady?
projects.tag: AI Scam Checker · UI/UX Case Study
bullets: Designed an AI scam checker for families that gives a calm verdict, underlines the red flags in the message and offers one next step, or asks a trusted person when unsure.

Compared five existing checkers, built three personas and a token-based light and dark design system, with accessibility built in: large text and touch targets, and verdicts never shown by colour alone.

projects.name: ShopUp
bullets: Ran user research and usability testing with 6 participants, plus persona, empathy map and competitive analysis.
Redesigned product discovery and checkout and added real-time delivery tracking, from information architecture to high-fidelity UI.

projects.name: Bewakoof
bullets: Audited the app against Nielsen's 10 heuristics, severity-rated the gaps and wrote prioritised recommendations.

projects.name: Talksy
bullets: Designed a messaging app in Figma covering onboarding, chat and settings, backed by a reusable design system.
